component.name: ThemeToggle
component.description: Single-button light/dark toggle. Renders two glyphs (sun and moon); the inline script in Layout shows the active one and persists the choice to localStorage under 'theme'.

useCases: let the user override the system colour scheme
drop into any nav or toolbar that needs theme control

commonPatterns.name: inside a nav
commonPatterns.description: Most common placement; both SideNav and MobileNav already include it.

commonPatterns.name: standalone on a page
commonPatterns.description: Render alone where neither nav is present, e.g. utility pages or the design system reference.

antiPatterns.scenario: rewriting the toggle script per page
antiPatterns.reason: The wiring lives once at the bottom of Layout.astro and finds every .theme-toggle on the page.
antiPatterns.alternative: Render the component; the existing script picks it up.

antiPatterns.scenario: reading data-theme from JS before the head script runs
antiPatterns.reason: The anti-flash bootstrap runs first and sets the correct value; doing it elsewhere risks a flash.
antiPatterns.alternative: Read document.documentElement.dataset.theme inside event handlers, not at module top-level.

parentConstraints: must be rendered inside Layout so the toggle script wires it up

interactions.click: Toggles data-theme on <html> and writes localStorage 'theme' = 'light' | 'dark'

aiHints.context: Reuse rather than rebuilding. Multiple instances are fine; all share state via data-theme + localStorage.
